notes: 审核包括全部可见example和collocation；只有结构校验合格进入word_content的块，不代表原始生成的被拒块已审核。
本文件不修改学习数据库，也不批准内容；统一由内容负责人核对hash后修订。

original_body.en: Mia completed her science project before the school fair.
original_body.zh: 米娅在学校展览会前完成了科学项目。

original_body.en: Please fill in your name and address on the complete form.
original_body.zh: 请在完整的表格上填写姓名和地址。

corrected_body.en: Mia completed her science project before the school fair.
corrected_body.zh: 米娅在学校展览会前完成了科学项目。

corrected_body.en: The story is not complete because its final page is missing.
corrected_body.zh: 这个故事不完整，因为最后一页不见了。

corrections.reason: complete form与继续填表的语境搭配生硬；改为清楚体现“完整的”的例句。

original_body.en: The puppy hid under the table during the loud storm.
original_body.zh: 暴风雨很大时，小狗躲在桌子下面。

original_body.en: I hid my birthday card in a drawer until tomorrow.
original_body.zh: 我把生日卡藏在抽屉里，留到明天再拿出来。

corrected_body.en: The puppy hid under the table during the loud storm.
corrected_body.zh: 暴风雨很大时，小狗躲在桌子下面。

corrected_body.en: I hid the birthday card in a drawer so my sister could not find it.
corrected_body.zh: 我把生日卡藏在抽屉里，让姐姐找不到它。

corrections.reason: 过去式hid与until tomorrow的时间关系含混，改为明确的过去叙述。

original_body.en: There are a lot of books on the table for our group.
original_body.zh: 桌上有很多书，是给我们小组的。

original_body.en: I felt lucky because I got the best lot in the school raffle.
original_body.zh: 我觉得很幸运，因为我在学校抽奖中抽到了最好的签。

corrected_body.en: There are a lot of books on the table for our group.
corrected_body.zh: 桌上有很多书，是给我们小组的。

corrected_body.en: We drew lots to decide who would go first in the game.
corrected_body.zh: 我们抽签决定谁在游戏中先开始。

corrections.reason: school raffle中got the best lot不自然且混淆抽奖与抽签；改用draw lots的标准用法。

original_body.en: Our science teacher showed us a picture of the planet Mars.
original_body.zh: 科学老师给我们看了一张火星的图片。

original_body.en: Earth is the only planet in our solar system with life.
original_body.zh: 地球是我们太阳系中唯一有生命的行星。

corrected_body.en: Our science teacher showed us a picture of the planet Mars.
corrected_body.zh: 科学老师给我们看了一张火星的图片。

corrected_body.en: Earth is the only planet in our solar system known to support life.
corrected_body.zh: 地球是太阳系中目前已知唯一存在生命的行星。

corrections.reason: 原句把唯一已知有生命写成绝对唯一有生命，证据范围表述过强。

original_body.en: repeat a word
original_body.zh: 重复一个单词

original_body.en: repeat a question
original_body.zh: 重复一个问题

original_body.en: repeat after sb.
original_body.zh: 跟某人重复

corrected_body.en: repeat a word
corrected_body.zh: 重复一个单词

corrected_body.en: repeat a question
corrected_body.zh: 重复一个问题

corrected_body.en: repeat after sb.
corrected_body.zh: 跟着某人复述；跟读

corrections.reason: repeat after sb.是跟着复述/跟读，不是泛泛的“跟某人重复”。

original_body.en: The children play football in the park after school.
original_body.zh: 孩子们放学后在公园踢足球。

original_body.en: Dad plays the piano while I finish my homework.
original_body.zh: 我做完作业时，爸爸在弹钢琴。

corrected_body.en: The children play football in the park after school.
corrected_body.zh: 孩子们放学后在公园踢足球。

corrected_body.en: Dad plays the piano while I finish my homework.
corrected_body.zh: 我做作业时，爸爸在弹钢琴。

corrections.reason: while I finish my homework表示做作业期间；原译“我做完作业时”误成完成时点。

original_body.en: fit well
original_body.zh: 很合身

original_body.en: fit into sth.
original_body.zh: 适合某物

original_body.en: fit the room
original_body.zh: 适合房间

corrected_body.en: fit well
corrected_body.zh: 很合身

corrected_body.en: fit into a box
corrected_body.zh: 能装进盒子

corrected_body.en: fit the room
corrected_body.zh: 适合房间

corrections.reason: fit into sth.原译“适合某物”掩盖装入/容纳义；换成明确常见搭配。

original_body.en: a school suit
original_body.zh: 校服套装

original_body.en: suit the weather
original_body.zh: 适合天气

original_body.en: suit sb. well
original_body.zh: 很适合某人

corrected_body.en: a dark suit
corrected_body.zh: 一套深色西装

corrected_body.en: suit the weather
corrected_body.zh: 适合天气

corrected_body.en: suit sb. well
corrected_body.zh: 很适合某人

corrections.reason: a school suit并非常见school uniform表达，易把suit误教成校服的常用说法。

original_body.en: Our team celebrated its victory with a picnic after the final game.
original_body.zh: 决赛后，我们队用野餐庆祝胜利。

original_body.en: The players thanked their coach after the hard victory.
original_body.zh: 艰难取胜后，队员们感谢了教练。

corrected_body.en: Our team celebrated its victory with a picnic after the final game.
corrected_body.zh: 决赛后，我们队用野餐庆祝胜利。

corrected_body.en: The players thanked their coach after their hard-earned victory.
corrected_body.zh: 取得来之不易的胜利后，队员们感谢了教练。

corrections.reason: hard victory搭配不自然，表达艰难赢得应为hard-earned victory。

original_body.en: My parents keep my birth photos in a small album.
original_body.zh: 我父母把我出生时的照片放在一本小相册里。

original_body.en: The old tree was the birth of a quiet park for our town.
original_body.zh: 那棵老树见证了我们镇上一个安静公园的诞生。

corrected_body.en: My parents keep my birth photos in a small album.
corrected_body.zh: 我父母把我出生时的照片放在一本小相册里。

corrected_body.en: We celebrated the birth of my little sister with a family dinner.
corrected_body.zh: 我们吃了一顿家庭聚餐，庆祝妹妹的出生。

corrections.reason: 原文The old tree was the birth...语义不成立，且译文“见证”并不对应was。

original_body.en: the bottom of a bag
original_body.zh: 包的底部

original_body.en: at the bottom of the hill
original_body.zh: 在山脚下

original_body.en: bottom line
original_body.zh: 底线

corrected_body.en: the bottom of a bag
corrected_body.zh: 包的底部

corrected_body.en: at the bottom of the hill
corrected_body.zh: 在山脚下

corrected_body.en: at the bottom
corrected_body.zh: 在底部

corrections.reason: bottom line常指最重要的事/最终结果/盈亏，并非中文原则“底线”的通用对应；换为课标基础空间义搭配。

original_body.en: Hang your wet coat by the window so it can dry.
original_body.zh: 把湿外套挂在窗边晾干。

original_body.en: Please dry the clean plates with this soft towel.
original_body.zh: 请用这条柔软的毛巾擦干净盘子。

corrected_body.en: Hang your wet coat by the window so it can dry.
corrected_body.zh: 把湿外套挂在窗边晾干。

corrected_body.en: Please dry the clean plates with this soft towel.
corrected_body.zh: 请用这条柔软的毛巾把洗干净的盘子擦干。

corrections.reason: dry the clean plates是把已干净的盘子擦干，原译“擦干净”误教dry=clean。

original_body.en: a strange sound
original_body.zh: 奇怪的声音

original_body.en: feel strange
original_body.zh: 感到陌生

original_body.en: a strange place
original_body.zh: 陌生的地方

corrected_body.en: a strange sound
corrected_body.zh: 奇怪的声音

corrected_body.en: feel strange
corrected_body.zh: 感觉异样；觉得不舒服

corrected_body.en: a strange place
corrected_body.zh: 陌生的地方

corrections.reason: 独立的feel strange通常是感觉异样/不舒服；原译感到陌生容易泛化错义。

original_body.en: A strange noise came from the kitchen while we watched TV.
original_body.zh: 我们看电视时，厨房里传来一阵奇怪的声音。

original_body.en: The new student felt strange in our class on his first day.
original_body.zh: 新同学第一天在我们班里感到很陌生。

corrected_body.en: A strange noise came from the kitchen while we watched TV.
corrected_body.zh: 我们看电视时，厨房里传来一阵奇怪的声音。

corrected_body.en: Everything felt strange to the new student on his first day.
corrected_body.zh: 对新同学来说，第一天周围的一切都很陌生。

corrections.reason: 用Everything felt strange to...清楚体现不熟悉义，避免the student felt strange误成不舒服。

original_body.en: Neither Tom nor his sister likes getting up early.
original_body.zh: 汤姆和他姐姐都不喜欢早起。

original_body.en: I asked for tea or juice, but she wanted neither.
original_body.zh: 我问她要茶还是果汁，但她两样都不要。

corrected_body.en: Neither Tom nor his sister likes getting up early.
corrected_body.zh: 汤姆和他姐姐都不喜欢早起。

corrected_body.en: I offered her tea or juice, but she wanted neither.
corrected_body.zh: 我问她想喝茶还是果汁，但她两样都不要。

corrections.reason: I asked for tea or juice是我索要茶或果汁，不是问她要哪一种；改为offered her与译文一致。

original_body.zh: 读小说

original_body.en: a short novel
original_body.zh: 短篇小说

original_body.en: a novel idea
original_body.zh: 新奇的想法

corrected_body.en: read a novel
corrected_body.zh: 读小说

corrected_body.en: a short novel
corrected_body.zh: 篇幅较短的小说

corrected_body.en: a novel idea
corrected_body.zh: 新奇的想法

corrections.reason: short novel不宜直接固定为短篇小说（short story）；按原搭配明确是篇幅较短的novel。
